# FileUpload { #anylumino.FileUpload }

```python
FileUpload(
    accept='',
    multiple=False,
    disabled=False,
    description='',
    icon='upload',
    button_style='',
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

File upload control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                     | Default    |
|--------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| accept | optional | Accepted file extensions or MIME types. | `''` |
| multiple | optional | Whether multiple files can be uploaded. | `False` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| icon | optional | Font Awesome icon name without the ``fa-`` prefix. | `'upload'` |
| button_style | optional | Predefined button style such as ``'primary'`` or ``'success'``. | `''` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [accept](#anylumino.FileUpload.accept) | File types to accept, empty string for all |
| [button_style](#anylumino.FileUpload.button_style) | Use a predefined styling for the button. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.FileUpload.disabled) | Enable or disable button |
| [error](#anylumino.FileUpload.error) | Error message |
| [icon](#anylumino.FileUpload.icon) | Font-awesome icon name, without the 'fa-' prefix. |
| [multiple](#anylumino.FileUpload.multiple) | If True, allow for multiple files upload |
| [style](#anylumino.FileUpload.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
| [value](#anylumino.FileUpload.value) | The file upload value |
